source.locator: General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada Mercury Global obligation row
source.summary: ISED's current contractor-obligations table identifies General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada against the Mercury Global strategic deployable terminals project and describes acquisition of infrastructure and services monitoring the Canadian Air Force secure communications network.

leads.evidenceLocator: General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada Mercury Global obligation row
followUpQuestions: Verify the active program and contract scope, fielded software and hardware baselines, security accreditation, interoperability, Canadian IP and data rights, sustainment metrics, upgrade path, and availability for the intended formation.
reviewWarnings: Public sources do not establish current program performance, classified configuration details, deployed-version baselines, cyber accreditation, sovereign software and data rights, support metrics, or which capabilities are available outside existing contracts.

source.title: SkyAlyne and PAL Aerospace reach agreement for RCAF CT-142Q Citadel
source.locator: July 2026 agreement, expected contract, scope, and finalization boundary
source.summary: PAL reports an agreement with SkyAlyne to enter an approximately CAD 750 million contract for CT-142Q Citadel aircraft modification, aircrew training, and in-service support under the RCAF Future Aircrew Training program; the release says finalization is anticipated over the following months.

leads.evidenceLocator: July 2026 agreement, expected contract, scope, and finalization boundary
followUpQuestions: Preserve the agreement-versus-final-contract distinction and verify executed terms, scope, aircraft modification baseline, training and sustainment milestones, Canadian workshare, acceptance criteria, and delivery risk.
reviewWarnings: The announced PAL–SkyAlyne agreement was not yet described as a finalized contract, and public sources do not establish final terms, delivery milestones, aircraft configuration, training throughput, acceptance criteria, program risk, or PAL's exact share of the prime contract.
